senses.gloss: f. (סָקַר II, with anorg. נ) [reddening,] a severe or insulting blow in the face (with the fist; oth. opin.: with the back of the hand; Rashi: with the saddle of an ass).
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 27b">B. Kam. 27ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. <cite ref="O00733"><he>סִינּוֹקְרִית</he></cite>; Ms. F. <he>סיניקרת</he>; ed. Sonc. <he>סטקרת</he>, corr. acc.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Y. ib. VIII, end, 6ᶜ <cite ref="O01488"><he>סקלונקית</he></cite>.
